question: Find the full names and majors of members who have incurred an expense over $100 and also attended at least one event that had more than 20 total attendees.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036", T2."XCL_031"
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1."XCL_042" = T2."XCL_030"
WHERE T1."XCL_034" IN (
  SELECT "XCL_022" FROM expense WHERE "XCL_020" > 100
)
AND T1."XCL_034" IN (
  SELECT "XCL_002" FROM attendance WHERE "XCL_001" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_001" FROM attendance GROUP BY "XCL_001" HAVING COUNT("XCL_002") > 20
  )
)
